title: Minimum Primitive Calls for SPRP Security
summary: The paper distinguishes reducing the call rate from proving optimality; the exact minimum primitive-call count for SPRP security remains unresolved.

formal_statement.body: Determine the minimum number of primitive calls required for SPRP security.

scope.domain: Primitive-call complexity of cryptographic constructions targeting strong pseudorandom permutation security.
parameters: Primitive-call count: the resource to be minimized while retaining SPRP security
scope.unresolved_remainder: Determine the exact minimum number of primitive calls necessary for SPRP security.
